Question 20
?

What is the trace in the xz-plane of the ellipsoid (x−3)216+y22+z2=1?

a
An ellipse with semi-axes 4 and 1, centered at (3,0) in the xz-plane
b
An ellipse with semi-axes 22 and 2, centered at (0,0) in the xz-plane
c
An ellipse with semi-axes 22 and 2, centered at (3,0) in the xz-plane
d
An ellipse with semi-axes 4 and 1, centered at (0,0) in the xz-plane
e
An ellipse with semi-axes 22 and 2, centered at (0,3) in the xz-plane
